Jenit Sulla: was a valhallan imperial guard officer who served from late m41 to early m42. a long period of her military career was spent with valhallan 296th and its successor regiment, valhallan 597th regiment under colonel . later became (according to some sources) only female guard officer to reach general's rank. prior to creation of 597th, was quartermaster sergeant of valhallan 296th, of valhalla's few all-female regiments. after regiment was decimated fighting against tyranids on corania, she was hastily promoted to 's staff as a lieutenant. she was of more vocal protestors against 296th's merger with of all-male 301st, being a firm believer in regimental traditions. in fact, a fight had broken out in mess hall of troopship between male and female troopers, as a result of 's impolitic decision to serve meal on 296th's regimental crockery. when criticized, she hotly retorted that crockery was always used on 296th's founding day, which meal happened to fall on. however, she later adjusted to merger of two regiments and served with distinction for years afterwards. at time of 597th's deployment to gravalax, was a platoon commander. during chaotic battle between rival factions of planet and a visiting tau battleforce, led her troops in several dangerous engagements. during an assault on a redoubt, she personally led her command squad in a flanking charge against position that drove enemy away. subsequent examiners of this action were divided about whether her actions were courageous or reckless, but they were undeniably effective. during final battle, when native inhabitants of gravalax were revealed to be acting under influence of genestealers, reluctantly led her troops in alliance with tau force to eradicate them. approximately year later, 597th was deployed to ice world of simia orichalcae to defend a vital promethium refinery from an invading ork waaagh!. was on front lines for much of campaign, and her unit inflicted punishing casualties on assaulting orks. also volunteered for highly dangerous mission of guarding an expedition from refinery to mine route being used by an approaching gargant. by good fortune, she was in right place at right time, to rescue commissar after he and a small party emerged from planet's underground caverns after a dangerous mission. five years after simia orichalcae debacle, accompanied 597th to adumbria, to fight off an expected chaos invasion. was also with 597th during its mission to periremunda, fighting off another incoming tyranid horde. 's later service is not described in detail, but she was eventually promoted to become only general of imperial guard. she would later write her memoirs, which took up at least two volumes: like a from flames: founding of 597th and like a on wing: early campaigns and glorious victories of valhallan 597th. in his private memoirs, , 597th's regimental commissar and reluctant hero of imperium, described as by far most eager, and most irritating, of regiment's junior officers. according to , she had blonde hair that she frequently wore in a ponytail, and had a long, narrow face that reminded of a horse's. as a combat officer she was headstrong, to , and courageous to point of recklessness. this last quality may explain part of 's personal dislike of her, as she would often commit herself to actions that would get her and her troops (and possibly himself, which concerned him most) killed. whatever 's misgivings about her, he acknowledged that she was an efficient commander and a competent tactician, and that troops under her command were extremely loyal to her. her superior, major , aptly summed up 's character and abilities with statement: "she'll probably go far, if she doesn't get herself killed ." ironically, herself remained largely oblivious to 's low opinion of her. in her own memoirs, she always described him in glowing terms, and considered him something of a mentor.. several times in her career, she claimed that she had decided on some of her most daring (and foolhardy) moves by asking herself what would do in her place - fortunately, according to inquisitor , without having any idea of true answer. used several excerpts from 's biographies to augment her annotations of archive. however, as always assured her reader, she did so with extreme reluctance, as 's prose style apparently left something to be desired ( often added disclaimers along lines of "readers with an appreciation of gothic language may wish to skip past this"). explained that, since was so often in thick of combat actions taking place outside 's perception, 's works gave reader a wider perspective than 's typically self-centered narrative ( often hastened to add that, had any other source been available, she would have used it). :see quotes imperial guard *according to , editing 's memoirs as of early m42, was only woman to reach general's rank in imperial guard. this is contradicted by several other sources: * novel 's honour by lee lightner features general militant esbet athelstane as lead commander of guard forces on besieged world of charys; *general reila vann is chief subordinate to general achilus in achilus crusade, according to deathwatch (game) sourcebooks. in audio book recordings of for , caves of ice, 's and duty calls, excerpts from 's memoirs are narrated by emma gregory, who also narrated james swallow's faith & and hammer & anvil. insofar as appears in main story of novels, narrated by , she is voiced by stephen perring.

Jenniker Soalm: , born , was a venenum assassin during heresy. originally growing up in slums of hive world of thaxted duchy alongside her brother , they were last surviving members of dynasty. rest of their family had been assassinated by rival aristocrats in continuous inter-dynastic wars of planet. orphaned and alone, both were taken in by schola progenium and made members of officio assassinorum. she displayed skill in chemistry, which made her an exceptional venenum assassin due to exotic poisons she could concoct. however by a desire to avenge his parents deaths, officio gave permission to massacre man who had ordered his parents' deaths. had done so, but killed many innocent bystanders in process. horrified by what her brother had done, changed her name so that she may never go by again. was reunited with her brother when she was picked to take part in officio assassinorum execution force to kill . she however became distracted by her mission with plight of local citizens of , who were waging a desperate guerrilla war against pro- rulers of planet. dagoneti also introduced her to lectitio divinitatus and converted her to idea that was a divine being. her interest in helping people of and new spiritualism created friction with her brother and execution force as a whole, and mission to kill went on without her. during subsequent failed attempt to kill , discovered plot by daemon pariah hybrid known as to assassinate . attempting to stop , was mortally wounded in process. her brother came upon her in her final moments, and she made him promise to track down for justice, not revenge.

Judd Clausel: right|thumb| is chaplain of fourth of ultramarines. has fought alongside several leaders of , including , and . a straightforward and violent man, he is prone to headlong charges and is often depicted graphically cutting enemies in two with his crozius arcanum. cares little for talk, and has reprimanded members of ecclesiarchy for discussing theology during meetings, and threatened planetary governors when they are slow to act. captain of fourth stated "chaplain speaks bluntly, but he is right to do so." was of most ruthless instructor sergeants at agilesus barracks on macragge (whether he was already a chaplain at this time is unknown). among aspirants under his charge were young , his best friend , and . all three of them heartily detested as a drillmaster, though they would become respected equals decades later. during 4th 's mission with as its captain, led in prayer aboard strike cruiser vae victus, and fought with distinction in pavonis campaign, including engagements outside governor's palace in brandon gate, and at battle of tembra ridge. also followed 4th to tarsis ultra, fighting with ferocity against hive fleet leviathan. after 's decimation by tyranids, assisted acting-captain and apothecary in selecting new aspirants to rebuild its numbers. as unyielding as he had been as a drill sergeant, insisted on maintaining 's high standards. also accompanied and 4th to espandor, defending against an ork waaagh!. in particular, he led a crack squad of assault marines on a jump pack assault on orks' gargant, and together he and killed orks' warboss. after invasion, in a rare mood of congratulation, he told that he had earned his captaincy beyond all doubt. when and returned unexpectedly from their death oath, was not afraid to express his reservations; two ultramarines had been abducted to eye of terror, and had yet to be convinced that they were free of chaotic taint. chaplain fought in several engagements during second pavonis campaign, including deep canyon six, estate and olzetyn. after campaign, he told that his leadership on pavonis had laid 's doubts to rest, and that anyone in future who questioned 's worth would answer to him. during bloodborn's invasion of ultramar, accompanied and 4th to calth. chaplain wears black armour of a chaplain. his skull helm is completely white with no notable technology visible save for pipes either side of his jaws. he is armed with frag and krak grenades, a rosarius, crozius arcanum and bolt pistol. has never been seen in battle without his jump pack and often leads a reserve unit of assault marines. whilst his armour is black, both his pauldrons have green edging showing his placement in fourth and ultramarine inners, strangely with no insignia on them. he is free from bionic implants and is bald on top but not sides, giving his head a holy, monk-like appearance. *"what is terror of death? that we die with our work incomplete. what is joy of life? to die knowing our task is done. i stand alongside warriors of honour, and warrior who acts out of honour cannot fail. his duty is honour itself. even a warrior's death--if it is honourable--is a reward and can be no failure, for it has come through duty. seek honour as you act, and you will know no fear. a fortress is a thing: commander its brain, walls its bones, sensors its eyes and ears, troops its , their weapons its fists. if organ fails, whole dies. and if whole dies, no single organ can survive alone. and above all, remember this... for a warrior only crime is cowardice."

Regina Kasteen: colonel was commander of 597th valhallan ice warriors regiment in 930s.m41. was a commander holding rank of captain in valhallan 296th, an all-female rear echelon regiment, when it was deployed against tyranids on corania. regiment took over 50% losses and its command hierarchy was all but wiped out, leaving her as senior surviving officer. 296th was merged with all-male 301st, a planetary assault regiment that had likewise been reduced to less than half-strength by fighting on corania. differences between two regiments were guaranteed to cause friction, and, to make matters worse, was made regimental colonel by virtue of three days' seniority over 301st's surviving (and much more combat-experienced) senior officer, , who was promoted to major and became her executive officer. tensions between two former regiments - which continued to use their former regimental identities - came to a head on board troopship righteous wrath on its way to new regiment's assignment on gravalax in 931.m41, in a mess room brawl resulting in deaths of several troopers and naval provosts over use of 296th's regimental dinnerware to serve meal. realizing situation, commissar - recently assigned to 296th/301st - had regiment renamed 597th (296 + 301), and ordered regiment integrated at squad level so that number of male and female troopers was equally dispersed. 's efforts gradually restored morale of regiment, and and came to work together and respect each other. led regiment during gravalax incident, intended primarily as a policing action to discourage planet's imperial population from defecting to tau empire. situation quickly became dangerous when tau ambassador was assassinated at a reception being hosted by governor. happened to be attending reception with , and two of them managed to establish a rapport with tau commander, that allowed them to prevent open war from erupting between two factions. also skillfully coordinated regiment in suppressing minor rebellion that broke out on planet, which escalated into open battle when insurgents were revealed to be under influence of genestealers. 597th's campaign was generally hailed as a success. about a year after gravalax incident, 597th was deployed to simia orichalcae, to defend a vital promethium refinery from an ork invasion. like all valhallans, was both well-trained and eager to combat orks, and approved of all her tactical decisions. when refinery administration insisted on being kept in loop, (with 's backing) declared martial law on planet when it became clear that administratum was unprepared to defend facility. she later ordered planet's evacuation with discovery of necron activity beneath facility, and coordinated a fighting retreat from orks, allowing regiment to escape planet with minimal casualties. about two years after gravalax incident, 597th was deployed to periremunda. as with gravalax, planet was undergoing civil unrest, which was presaging arrival of a tyranid hive fleet. although admitted to feeling a trace of fear at facing tyranids again - since they had chewed their comrades to pieces on corania - she acted with her usual level-headedness, and effectively coordinated defense of planet's plateaux from incoming swarms. early on in campaign, inquisitor , who had foreknowledge of tyranids' approach, allowed to share this knowledge with and , deciding that they were trustworthy. of 597th's most difficult trials came approximately five years after gravalax incident, when 597th was deployed to adumbria, which was expecting an invasion by a chaos warband known as ravagers. during initial journey, tensions ran high between 597th and 229th regiment of tallarn desert raiders who were being deployed along with them. tallarns had a conservative disdain for guard regiments that included women in their ranks, and their regimental commissar, , was unable to hide his open astonishment that 597th had a woman as its commanding officer. while 597th was being deployed on planet's night side, several minor skirmishes with chaos cultists suggested that situation was more complex than imperial forces believed. after ravagers made their attacks on planet, noticed a pattern which eluded most of other command staff, which revealed that ravagers had come to stop a slaaneshi cult that was conducting rituals to summon a daemon. based on her observations, was able to deduce site of last ritual, and diverted a troop transport to site. , a long-time rival of 's, believed that was a coward looking for any excuse to avoid frontlines, and followed with intent of arresting him. 's ill-considered remark that had seized on his "petticoat colonel['s]... ridiculous theory" enraged valhallan troopers accompanying , and prompted commissar to challenge to a duel if he did not apologize to . 's "ridiculous theory" was, in fact, entirely correct, and 's impulsive actions succeeded in interrupting cultists' summoning ritual, which would have resulted in transforming adumbria into a daemon world. afterwards, was warmed by 's defense of her and she and stood by him when he faced tribunal that insisted on convening. tribunal decided in 's favor, and , having seen 's skills with a chainsword and laspistol firsthand, humbly apologized to rather than duel him. ... when 296th and 301st were consolidated, was protective of her former comrades of 296th, and was hostile towards her counterparts in 301st. once regiment was fully combined and changes had introduced took hold, took to her position as commander of mixed-gender 597th. before governor's reception on gravalax, she admitted to feeling her youth and relative inexperience, but shored up her self-confidence by assuring her that her promotion was entirely deserved. in his private memoirs, reflected that, although it was simple luck that had elevated her to command (by virtue of being only senior officer left after corania), it was best fortune for regiment that she proved to be such a gifted leader. like most imperial guard officers, had very little patience for bureaucratic pandering of administratum ( later wrote in archive that had an even lower tolerance for idiots than he did), and adopted a soldier's blunt approach to problem-solving that suited her well. by time of simia orichalcae deployment, she was fully confident of her own authority, and declared martial law rather than engage administratum deputies in pointless debate about her decisions. for instance, when she proposed mining route by which an ork gargant was approaching facility, refinery administrator warned about dangers of damaging refinery and demanded an alternative strategy. Schaeffer: |name = |image =schaefferheadshot.jpg |caption = |title = |homeworld = |birth =c. 700.m41 |active period =m41 - present |death = |cause of death = |species =human |type = |gender =male |relatives = |occupation =colonel of imperial guard |preceded by = |succeeded by = |faction = *imperium of man **imperial guard ***13th penal legion |notes = }} colonel is an officer of imperial commissariat and commander of 13th penal legion, also known as "last chancers". while most imperial citizens, especially rank-and-file of imperial guard, believe that penal legion troopers - often murderers, , blasphemers, thieves, rapists and other assorted scum - should be executed for their crimes, is a firm believer of granting a "last chance" for his men to redeem themselves. he provides this chance by leading them into suicidal missions. those "fortunate" enough to be offered recruitment into 13th legion often choose summary execution rather than serve under . during their mission on armageddon, revealed himself to be over three hundred years old, his life extended and his body reconstructed by tech-priests of inquisition. among his injuries, he has had his eyes replaced ( ice- eyes that are his most distinguishing characteristic came from a tech-priest who sinned against machine god), his spine rebuilt after being crushed by a tank, and his arm replaced after it was shot off by a plasma bolt. he is also a of close combat, either with his customary power sword and plasma pistol, or -to-. thumb|center|colonel miniature in his foreword to last chancers (omnibus), gav thorpe explained that concept for 13th legion began as a rescue team of imperial guard specialists, and for that reason, shares his name with major "dutch" , arnold schwarzenegger's character in predator. was originally intended to be a major, but, after conferring with andy jones, who suggested integrating penal and premise of earlier film dirty dozen, was "promoted" to colonel and nature of his "team" changed.

Schuto: was an astra militarum commissar. he was among imperial forces that unsuccessfully defended lazulai from a tyranid invasion. as world began to fall to xenos, after months of warfare, was among regiments based in cobalt fortress, which was under general 's command. commissar would then maintain discipline of fortress' guardsmen, until he died in battle. after 's death, captain of cadian 2012th took it upon himself to carry out commissar's role and be responsible for delivering 's judgement on fortress' wayward guardsmen. this later led into conflict with major of catachan cmiii, when captain attempted to execute cmiii guardsman .
Scion of Plagues: thumb|right|200px| was name given to of eight individuals which made up mysterious of , an organization within black legion dedicated to reconstituting anathame. only other chaos space marine on besides , was a hulking putrid devotee of nurgle armed with a massive axe and scythe. he was a member of of old , though it is never stated which (though death guard is most likely). he was also most recent addition of , and was least effected by its constant infighting. during battle of stygius , and his army of plague marines and nurgle abominations confronted imperial forces boarding blackstone fortress used as their base. his forces reaped heavy losses on imperials and seemed poised for victory under mordian guard sergeant miraculously ascended to a and incinerated chaos space marine with holy light.
Scipio Vorolanus: is a space marine sergeant from ultramarines 2nd , under captain . his tactical squad, nicknamed " thunderbolts," specializes in reconnaissance and deep strike missions, especially when dedicated scout units are not available. during assault on black reach in 855 m41, thunderbolts were deployed to black reach with rest of second against waaagh! zanzag, and formed part of drop pod assault launched by . fought valiantly against several heavily-armed ork nobs, allowing ultramarines to liberate ghospora hive, though thunderbolts lost of their own, brother hekor. during subsequent hunt for warboss zanzag's lair, ordered and four of his best marines to attach themselves to sergeant 's scout squads, and managed to discover orks' base, a vast natural cavern. during subsequent assault launched by , thunderbolts fought bravely, as battle carried orks and space marines into surrounding open area, where killed zanzag in single combat. had mixed feelings at end of campaign. if second was divided between those who admired their captain's valour and those who criticized him for his recklessness, belonged to neither faction at beginning of campaign, but at end leaned towards wary. on , he had witnessed 's bravery firsthand, and felt inspiring effects of his leadership; on other, he could not forget lives of ultramarines with which had won victory. during damnos incident, and his squad were deployed to damnos along with rest of second . during attack of bloodborn on ultramar, in 854999.m41, 2nd was deployed to espandor. after some initial skirmishes, captain decided that best way to bring campaign to a swift end was to locate and kill attacking force's commander, corsair queen . several squads were dispatched to infiltrate enemy camps. thunderbolts were dispatched to city of corinth. through a combination of guile, ingenuity, and hard fighting, thunderbolts made their way into city, posing as chaos space marines. for next week, and his battle-brother nivian, who had lost an arm taking an enemy rhino, did a foot patrol to find . all they found was a disordered, fractious army, which disgusted both astartes. running low on supplies and knowing that they needed to act, and thunderbolts charged bloodborn's stronghold, and held off enemy forces long enough to confirm 's presence. as soon as they signalled their 's hq, was surprised when arrived with reinforcements, almost immediately. himself summoned thunderbolts to fight alongside his command squad as he engaged in single combat. when corsair queen lopped off ancient 's arm, prevented standard from touching ground and bore it aloft in 's place. corsair queen was better sword-fighter, and managed to critically wound , but he seized her and held her still while impaled her through back with standard. with her dead, rest of bloodborn scattered quickly. explained that he had already deployed bulk of 2nd to corinth, on a hunch that would make her base there. expressed some doubt about captain's recklessness, and was rankled when brushed this aside and claimed full credit for victory on espandor.
Sebastian Thor: was shadowy and ill-defined figure who led confederation of light and people of imperium in overthrow of insane high . it is conjectured that was a simple preacher born on world of dimmamar and little else is known of him before his rise to power. during reign of as was at head of ecclesiarchy, began to proselytize his people and lead them into opposition against . dispatched a fleet to crush rebellion and kill , but fleet was wiped out by a warp storm that came to be known as storm of 's wrath, suggesting that himself was aiding . after this, imperium erupted into rebellion against . soon began a crusade to terra, attracting several space marine and adeptus mechanicus to support him. after 's defeat, worked closely with fabricator-general of adeptus mechanicus as well as space marine chapter masters in restoring rule of law to terra and reforming imperium so that a madman like could never rise to power again. allies put 's lackeys on trial and executed those found guilty, restored high lords of terra, and worked with inquisition to end assassin wars of vindication. however, position of ecclesiarch remained empty, and many thought to naturally be its next position holder. however, to shock of all, refused as he was too busy preaching imperial cult on northern rim of galaxy. soon refused additional requests, and insulted high lords of terra declared him to be a , dispatching forces to apprehend him. willingly turned himself in when confronted by adeptus arbites, and a trial on terra personally overseen by high lords began. lasting months, verdict was eventually delivered by captain-general of adeptus custodes, stating that was innocent of every charge brought out against him. mass celebration erupted across terra at news. again, high lords offered position of ecclesiarch and again he refused, citing his desire to spread word of rather then sit on ecclesiarch's throne on terra. high lords erupted in outrage and indignation, yet captain-general of adeptus custodes took aside and whispered a single message into his ear. though no other heard what was said, it is commonly thought captain threatened with death if he refused. however, to adulation of adoring masses, announced he would accept position of ecclesiarch. however, agreed to take position only on a number of conditions. that he could travel freely across galaxy, have unswerving backing of high lords, and make whatever changes to holy synod that he saw fit. high lords agreed, and became 292nd ecclesiarch. for best part of next century, worked tirelessly in reforming in imperium. reformations included establishing synod ministra on ophelia vii and disbanding frateris templar, creating sisters of battle in its place. only returned to terra at age of 112, where he died six months later. his preserved head is currently in possession of infinite.

people of armageddon and as old eye by orks) is an imperial guard commissar famous for his participation in second and third wars for armageddon, in which he twice fought against ork forces of warlord ghazghkull mag uruk thraka. his leadership and bravery during these conflicts have made him of greatest heroes of imperium. was born vaarden on world of taos iii. orphaned at age of 7, he was raised by his tough but caring grandfather, , who himself was a veteran sergeant of imperial guard. it was from him that he learned art of survival and combat. when orks invaded taos iii, 's grandfather was killed and he spent 3 years alone on world, surviving in forest and laying traps to kill greenskins. when imperial reinforcements arrived they found , who had taken on name in honour of his grandfather. shortly after he was taken in by schola progenium and trained to become a member of militarum tempestus. he and his fellow progena, , became infamous in their dorm. initially being trained and serving as storm troopers, and eventually became commissars. in their posting as commissars, and were placed under tutelage of commissar . three were attached to mortisian infantry regiment during an investigation into a possible heretic uprising on planet mistral. led 252nd legion on moon of aionos against heretic forces around a hundred years before second war for armageddon. in his youth, had learned ork language from a captured raider, and became an expert in way ork mind worked. before second war for armageddon began, in 941.m41, he had already served in a dozen campaigns as a commissar with armageddon's planetary defence forces and gained a reputation for unswerving loyalty to . in fact, he was already of advanced age at time of war and was scheduled to retire on day orks landed. when warnings of ork landing came, was on armageddon to assist in founding of 4th armageddon regiment. swiftly observed that ghazghkull was a more cunning and tenacious warlord than previously encountered among orks, and ordered planet's astropaths to send a call for help. , inept overlord of armageddon, insisted that armageddon could deal with ork threat on its own, and banished to hades hive as punishment for circumventing 's authority. was grievously mistaken. under his incompetent leadership, planet bit by bit until orks reached hades hive. here, commissar commanded defending forces, inspiring them to a fanatical degree of bravery and resolve. not a single soldier was executed for cowardice during fighting at hades hive, even in face of overwhelming ork numbers. himself was always on front lines during fighting, receiving many battle wounds. frustrated about defiance of hive hades, ghazghkull sent of his strongest warbosses, ugulhard, to deal with 's resistance. as monstrous ork and his followers overran hive's outer defense, commissar stepped forward to challenge warboss. he was grievously wounded in this duel, as ugulhard severed 's right arm with a swipe from his power klaw. such a wound would have killed a lesser man, but 's will allowed him to not only survive, but to decapitate ugulhard with his chainsword and then pull power klaw from his corpse and hold it aloft for all to see. sight caused orks to flee in terror, while simultaneously causing human defenders to charge forward with renewed vigour. only after orks had been routed did allow himself luxury of passing out. right|thumb| holding a decapitated [[ork head aloft with his power klaw.]] imperial defence of hades hive was so implacable that eventually ghazghkull himself joined attack, leading his forces from front. he tried to take hive by every strategy he could imagine, but countered them all. eventually, hades hive became a personal battle between two warriors. when ghazghkull upon hive, realised they could not hold their position. in a series of daring shuttle runs, remaining forces managed to escape. himself received a near-fatal wound in combat with ghazghkull, and hovered near death during final stage of evacuation. eventually, war ended with arrival of commander of angels, whom defenders of armageddon turned to for leadership. although space marines' offensive pushed orks off planet, 's defence of hades hive was recognized as turning point of war, and he was hailed as saviour of armageddon. in 944.m41, three years after end of second war, formally came out of retirement and requested a military expedition to thoroughly cleanse surrounding worlds of ork raiders, his particular goal being to hunt down ghazghkull. such planet, golgotha, was to be where this purge would end for imperials in a crushing defeat by ork defences. 's personal baneblade, fortress of arrogance was abandoned and himself was captured by ghazghkull. after grueling torture and forced labor with other captured humans, led a slave revolt aboard ghazghkull's space hulk. however uprising failed, and once again found himself in greenskin captivity. was then brought before ghazghkull much more, and much to commissar's surprise warboss gave him a shuttle and let him go. ghazghkull stated that good enemies were hard to come by and felt that warboss' planned re-invasion of armageddon would be much more fun with on other side. however, would later vengefully return to golgotha at head of an army of mechanicum which included titans, skitarii, and an ordinatus engine to scour world of orks. orks later counter-attacked, retaking planet. third war for armageddon would prove to be a much harder battle than second. arrived back on planet two weeks before invasion began. by overwhelming vote, he was offered supreme command of all imperial forces on planet, and he accepted. before war commenced, had remains of fortress of arrogance salvaged from golgotha and repaired, to serve as his personal command vehicle. ghazghkull opened conflict by obliterating hades hive from orbit, effectively throwing down gauntlet to his old adversary. fortunately, had foreseen this attack; where another commander might have diverted resources and men to protecting city he had so ferociously defended before, acted out of cold military logic and without a trace of sentimentality. seeing that hades hive could not be defended, he had it evacuated before orks attacked, and concentrated his forces elsewhere. his order was to send all remaining imperial aircraft to destroy as many of orks as possible before they could touch ground. eventually, orks landed their roks, providing them with prebuilt fortresses. personally led assault on of these with a force of cadian shock troopers. eventually third war for armageddon degenerated into a gruelling war of attrition, thwarting ghazghkull's hopes for a clear victory. when ghazghkull fled armageddon and black templars prepared to give , petitioned high marshal to allow him to join their quest; agreed, and immediately set off, determined to rid galaxy of ghazghkull for good. after much pursuit and were able to finally catch up to ghazghkull. however while they were able to corner his flagship kill wrecka in ensuing battle of haunted gulf, ghazghkull was able to escape into warp and begin his waaagh!. when saw ork warlord vanish, he slumped and knew that his escape meant ill for galaxy. recently, it has been rumored that is dead. of lost souls on terra is said to have rung for him, but exact details of his fate are unclear. death at hands of ghazghkull or a returned have been proposed. there is also speculation that he is not dead at all. 's weaponry reflects both his will and his keen understanding of ork mind, which respects only strength and is also highly superstitious. in aftermath of second war, he replaced his missing with same power klaw that had taken it, specially modified to fit his arm. it is powerful enough to kill in swipe. after hearing rumors from orks that he could kill with a glance, he had his missing eye replaced with a bionic replacement, eye, that can a laser beam, similar in effect to a laspistol at close range. image: old.jpg|commissar (1992) image:.jpg|commissar (2000) image:fortressofarrogance.jpg| atop fortress of arrogance. *"heroes of armageddon! you have withstood evil savagery of orks, and they having nothing left for you to fear. so raise high black banners of vengeance - now is our time."—during third war for armageddon
Sebastien Montante: was fabricator marshal of tarsis ultra in late m41, when world came under attack by hive fleet leviathan. as fabricator marshal, was both planetary governor and a leading member of council of industry which governed capital city of , and nominal head of planet's pdf forces. did not make a favorable impression on leaders of ultramarines' fourth when they arrived on tarsis ultra, having arranged a sumptuous welcoming feast (which was brusquely cancelled) and expressing enthusiasm for "adventure" of fighting a real war - apparently not grasping horrors of fighting against tyranids. sergeant was inclined to dismiss him as an empty-headed fool, but managed to impress space marines with his efficiency and dedication. by his own admission, he was not a soldier, but he was a -class logistician and administrator. at his instruction, pdf units began drilling as soon as word of tyranids' approach was received; food, water, medicine, and ammunition were stockpiled in caches under city; and arriving defenders from ultramarines, mortifactors, and two imperial guard regiments, all found their requests for supplies being met promptly and in full. thanks to , imperial forces of were assured of having full ammunition and regular meals at all times, even during worst of invasion. was also instrumental on council of industry, endorsing 's instructions to demolish buildings standing between defensive walls, in order to deny incoming tyranids cover. when several members of council—including —protested, dissolved council and granted command of city to colonel , of imperial guard commanders. feeling that he had no further role to play as an administrator, he attempted to join ranks of pdf, declaring he needed to fight for his world. gently dissuaded him, instead drawing on 's knowledge of planet's orbital defenses to devise a counterattack against tyranids. did take part in final ground battle against tyranids. although and several others had to save his life several times, none of them could doubt his personal bravery. he was killed fighting on walls, by a volley of spikes fired by several tyranid warriors. after battle was over, 's body was recovered and laid in honour in imperial palace, and several priests of tarsis ultra were petitioning for him to be made a . privately, reflected that , a humble and selfless servant of his people, would have been much amused by notion of being declared a . character of may have been inspired by st. , a catholic who was martyred after being shot repeatedly with arrows.
Sebastion: forge was ranking techmarine in scythes of chapter after fall of sotha. in evacuation of sotha, was stationed aboard cruiser nova prospectum. ship was thrown off-course by shadow in warp, but was eventually able to reach chapter's muster point in miral system. indeed, nova prospectum was in a considerably better state of repair than most of chapter's surviving fleet, thanks to and his techmarines. was ordered by captain , acting of fleet, to take nova prospectum to retrieve contents of a series of supply caches that scythes maintained across sothara. when tyranids later attacked miral system as well, took a significant portion of chapter's fleet and, rather than using them to defend system, took them to rendezvous with and ensure success of his mission. afterwards, 's and 's ships returned to miral system, their cargo holds loaded with rare weaponry and ordnance. as forge , it was 's responsibility to ensure that new recruits were trained as techmarines as chapter was rebuilt. he had identified neophyte as having a natural gift for practical problem solving, and had begun his early training shortly before neophyte's death in 21st salvation team, under sergeant . he also accepted neophyte for possible apprenticeship to forge after he delivered considerable amounts of power armour recovered from various tyranid hive fleets. had an ongoing project, which was restoration of damaged or lost terminator armour. after fall of sotha, scythes were apparently left with only three such suits, and 's acquisition of a fourth partial suit was a major leap forwards in putting together a codex-approved squad. he wore a full servo-harness, and was equipped with a bulky ocular array.
Seena: was a guardswoman of tanith and only regiment. worked as a loom-girl in vervunhive. when vervunhive was attacked by fallen hive ferrozoica during worlds crusade, she joined of scratch militia formations to fight back against zoicans. following conclusion of war, vervunhive was reduced to a ruin. was of those scratch soldiers to enlist with astra militarum, joining tanith . she became part of a heavy weapons team, handling weapon itself while her fellow guardswoman served as a loader. and almost died in a combat drop at cirenholm on phantine when their drop-ship was hit by anti-air and crash landed on outside of cirenholm's secondary dome. two of them were carried off of dome when remains of drop-ship slid off it, but they were caught when their rope snagged on a vent. they were saved by trooper , who heard their calls for help and was able to get a rope to them.
Sefoni: is a rare and formidable psyker in service to inquisitor . she has served inquisitor for a number of years and might know more secrets than even inquisitor's most trusted interrogators. is currently assisting inquisitor's warband aboard mourningstar via clairvoyant scrying of going-ons within hive tertium and training forces requisitioned by inquisition in psykhanium. rogue trader, shipmistress has even requested that offer her training services in psykhanium to her voidsmen crew. is able to speak to individuals directly via telepathy. she is also able to alter memories and even personalities of individuals, whether willing or not. barber-chirurgeon of warband, oska krall, even works with her to offer a personality scourge service aboard mourningstar, a service that can potentially rewrite an individual's recollection of their entire life's history. affectionately refers to oska as a creative genius and this service they offer as an artistic collaboration. this procedure requires use of valuable prismata crystals. although it isn't explicitly authorised by inquisitor, interrogator allows it to continue since it might allow for a back door into minds of their warband's rabble. has a playful and mischievous personality. she often refers to warband's rabble as her "playthings" and enjoys watching them struggle and shed in visions she conjures during psykhanium training sessions.
Segas: {|align="right" style="background-color:#b6b6b6" |align="right"| |- |align="right"| |} was chaplain of scythes of chapter of space marines. was a chaplain of ultramarines second at time of third founding. seeking to remove evidence of both imperium secundus and 's defiance of his own codex astartes by maintaining a phantom 11th , chapter sent and to sotha to offer captain , last surviving member of aegida , a choice of reassignment to 5th or continuing to guard pharos as of a new 'aegida chapter'. , initially appalled that had initiated another founding, reluctantly agreed to found a new chapter, but chose to name them scythes of . and joined new chapter, along with 72 veterans of orlan conquest. was a noted scholar of chapter lore, being well versed in writings of , and , amongst others. after his death, 's remains were interred on reliquary world of egottha.
Sehalla: was an imperial navy captain during plague of unbelief, on side of . met and joined with on planet rhanda and they proceeded to conquer an empire together. he appeared to have a cautious mind, as he agreed with when he was told to stop short of bakka in fear of empire being discovered by imperium and ordered retreat from fenris when space wolves' fleet arrived. he protected his ships ahead of other forces, and only dropped out of warp to pick up for briefest amount of time before retreating again. his counterpart in ground forces was colonel , who also met on rhanda.
Sejanus: was a general during macharian crusade. was right man to commander solar and was by his side throughout campaign. a huge man with bright hair and a massive , was always beside , in all things he did. he never questioned wisdom of methods they used and always undertook his orders with ruthless efficiency. he was also commander of mordian forces during macharian crusade, it is assumed that he was a general in rank. his most famous action was to tell that crusade was over when they reached ultima macharia. men were too afraid to talk to due to his fiery temper, but they could talk to who in turn sent message on to . date of his death is unknown, but he is said to have remained loyal to imperium during subsequent macharian heresy. after war he became imperial commander of macharian sector. while his reign was a long , it was not personally joyous for general. he lost a considerable number of children in imperium's wars, and renamed cytheris sub-sector after of his beloved daughters who rose to colonel but was slain during macharian heresy. after his death, was declared an imperial .
Selena Agna: thumb|right|canoness canoness of order of sacred rose was commander of sisters of battle present on kaurava system during kaurava conflict. apart from fighting xenos and heretics in system, she also fought against ravens and 252nd conservator regiment, deeming former a threat for not ceding authority to her forces, and latter as corrupted, responsible in some way for warp storm. when sisters defeated all other factions, they began a massive purge to rid system of anything and anyone suspected of heresy. planets of system became monastery worlds with ecclesiarchal citadel for each of six major military orders of adepta sororitas. millions sisters of battle visited system as a holy pilgrimage and reminder of their crusade in kaurava system and to gather for "prayer and preparation". if sisters of battle were defeated, was killed in a of aimed at her head, while ordered "sisters, we must go as martyrs! we must go up in flames!" awaited enemy approach, and when they closed on her, she activated a device that caused herself and enemies near her to be burnt to death. if defeated by space marines, all survivors were treated with utmost deference, and were given swift medical aid and safe passage back to convent sanctorum on ophelia vii where they were at mercy of inquisition. if defeated by imperial guard forces, general vance stubbs remarked on his victory as a sign of 's will for their control over system. her name, , is derivative of selene, moon goddess of roman mythology; whereas her last name refers to hindu goddess - agni - which is fitting, given sisters of battle favour use of flame-based weaponry in combat.
Selenus: is apothecary to ultramarines' 4th as of late m41. long-serving apothecary to 4th , accompanied captain on several of his early missions, including battles on pavonis and tarsis ultra. in aftermath of devastating action on tarsis ultra, and captain 's banishment from chapter, , along with chaplain , assisted acting-captain in screening 's new recruits and rebuilding 's numbers. also accompanied 4th on its reconnaissance mission to espandor, where he was instrumental in retrieving geneseed of ultramarines who had fallen on frigate 's honour, before their remains could be ravaged by orks. after 's reinstatement to 4th , also fought alongside him during 's second deployment to pavonis. during invasion of ultramar, appointed to his newly-formed command squad, "swords of calth". reflected that, although his medical skills were , was and foremost a warrior, and his knowledge of physiology of all species made him that much more devastating in combat. survived desperate fight in catacombs of calth against warriors warsmith , and carried out shadow captain 's request to extract geneseed of , a renegade guard who had nonetheless sided with ultramarines during final battle.
Selgar Dorgaddon: was captain of sons of ' 10th during siege of terra. by end of crusade, was a regular battle brother in 10th . according to , he was of kind disposition at time. unlike his superior , sided with during battle of isstvan iii; he subsequently rose in ranks of legion. in process, he became increasingly cruel and monstrous, through a fragment of his original personality seemed to still cling to him like a ghost. commanding 10th , by final stages of siege had fully committed himself to madness of chaos and was ignoring 's orders. he eventually encountered and her column of refugees, recognising former remembrancer from her time with captain's legion. this was not enough to stay his , and gave order to attack refugees and then prepared to execute . however he was brutally killed by 's champion before his could a single blow and 10th was destroyed by 's own forces, shortly afterwards.
Selkar Fang: sir was a of dominion's house rau and piloted armiger jester. he is of freeblade , who had through a political marriage with baroness of house stryder. initially refused to marry , due to his bloodline's low-status, but finally relented when house rau would not offer a more suitable replacement. she felt they had only done so, in order to weaken house stryder's chances of securing a high monarch candidate that would favor their house. only nobles born from both houses can become candidates on lists for high monarch, but their initial standing depends on their parents' bloodlines. because of 's low-status, knew their child would thus be on low end of lists. this greatly angered her and as a result, had it written in a contract that their son, , would have her last name and not 's. he agreed to this, but sir would later be declared a hero of dominion, when he died saving high monarch 's life, during battle of blazing . this greatly annoyed , however, as it meant she could no longer publicly speak ill of her husband again.
Semyon: was an adept of martian priesthood and guardian of dragon (mag'ladroth, ancient c' supposedly entombed beneath surface of mars). by m41, was a semi-legendary figure among mechanicus; some doubted whether he had ever existed at all, while other rumors said that he had died during martian schism. according to magos , 's researches included revolutionary new methods for grafting augmetic limbs and producing electrographic images of a person's "phantom limbs".
Senavael: is chapter of wolfspear chapter. like all of its initial members, he served in indomitus crusade fleet ' unnumbered sons forces, which was commanded by commander . after battle of raukos, however, and fleet's other surviving descended unnumbered sons, were formed into wolfspear chapter. then charged them with watching over pit of raukos, to ensure no chaos forces emerging from there would threaten imperium. they numbered 500 in total and was chosen as their chapter , 108/beta-kalapus-9.2's would serve as their homeworld. daemons would strike there every night, though, and to make agreed that was true and told chapter they would leave, if wolfspear were not interested in being judged worthy. before three could do so, however, stopped them. he then asked if wolfspear would be wolfspear against daemons that daily invaded their homeworld. it was as two forces clashed, that decided wolfspear were worthy and contacted his fleet. aboard it, was large force of space wolves, had reinforcements, wolfspear was brought to a full 1000 space marines and with his task now done, departed with his fleet shortly afterwards. *while is claimed to be wolfspear's chapter in short story Seneca: was a primaris space marine of ultramarines chapter. early in indomitus crusade, due to chapter's third being delayed fighting a chaos force in koryndil reach, captain directed chaplain to command a mission to planet quradim. was given command of a contingent of ultramarines, including , aboard destroyer light of iax. to chaplain's shock, marines he was to command were giants clad in an unfamiliar pattern of power armour. mollified 's concerns, however, by playing a holomessage recorded by ultramarines' primarch, . despite his lack of offical rank, was informal leader of an intercessor squad. his fellow intercessors (ariston, caprico, kyros and ) referred to as "", due to fact that he was of five of them to complete marines' training program on mars and be placed into stasis. following mission on quradim, was formally promoted to rank of sergeant and inducted into eighth .
Sentikan: is chapter of angels sanguine. was of several chapter masters who answered 's summons to conclave of angels' successor on , in aftermath of insurrection. he later withdrew to battle cruiser unseen with body of a murdered captain, and was ordered by to obliterate angels fortress-monastery from orbit if it was overrun by bloodfiends. encouraged by , he voted with other chapter masters to donate a portion of their neophytes to replace angels' losses.
Sentor Jool: was firstblade of knights of , when they aided as it faced an invasion by hive fleet leviathan. by order of angels' chapter , , knights of were sent to defend - a task they did not object 's progression through his chapter's rank was marred only by a barely controlled battle-lust that eventually tempered into restraint and wisdom with age and experience. however, uncommonly for a librarian, he still favoured spending time matching his martial skills against his fellow battle-brothers rather than being locked away meditating over arcane secrets. this, along with his raw power as a psyker, has long earned him a reputation as a relentless fighter in battle, and who takes no greater delight than hacking down enemy sorcerers and witches in personal combat. at time of badab war's beginning, was a veteran of centuries of battle, and already served as magister to two commanders of his chapter, and further added to his legend by leading mission to recover commander 's body following betrayal at grief. with ascension of to rank of commander, became his closest adviser and most trusted field commander, fighting on front lines of second battle of sagan and conquest of piraeus. in combat, wears armour of selket, a suit of artificer armour which incorporates a psychic hood. Djoseras: was a royal member of necrons' ithakas dynasty and for a time to its throne. son of and elder brother to , saved his younger brothers life during 's attempted regicide by instead insisting he be banished to sedh. did little after besides scribble scrimshaw on bodies of his immortals as ithakan court languished under de facto rule of vizier and their mad , who by now was succumbing to flayer curse. took his place at throne of ithakas for a brief period following 's flight to world in face of a massive imperial crusade. overthrowing both and , he led defense of their crownworld of antikef against angels encarmine and imperial titans. during battle, used a tachyon arrow to destroy of human titans in a single shot. volunteered to stay behind and delay humans so could evacuate remainder of ithakas and ensure survival of their people. alongside his immortals, whose scrimshaw was revealed to be their names and deeds from their time as proud necrontyr warriors, died fighting.
Dogbit Karg: was a gang leader in underhive of necromunda's hive , who murdered hive world's imperial commander, , in 646.m41. met a suspected house delaque agent, at glory hole some time before he carried out his assault and after some talks, came to an agreement in between drinks of wild snake. is purported to have died alongside his victim after a vicious battle.
Dohon Domor: "shoggy" was a guardsman of tanith and only. prior to enlisting in astra militarum, lived and worked in tanith attica as an apprentice engineer to a timber haulier. he began his military career in tanith as a trooper, however he was trusted with specialised equipment - in particular he often served as a minesweeper. he was picked to join 's team during search for an ancient technological treasure on menazoid epsilon. during mission was wounded by shrapnel and lost his eyesight, but was later fitted with big, frog-like optical implants which have given him him his nickname, 'shoggy', after a bug-eyed amphibian native to tanith. an excellent minesweeper specialist, 's abilities were only enhanced by his new augmetic eyes, which allow him to see over longer distances and scan for heat traces, though they are vulnerable to water and will blind him if they get wet. by 771.m41, just prior to tanith deployment on phantine, had been promoted to rank of sergeant. is also a talented leader, commanding twelve platoon which acted as 's personal honour guard during battle of civitas beati on herodor. after presumed loss of during mission and merging of tanith with belladon 81st recon he was promoted to captain and given command of k . during combat on ancreon sextus, 's eyes allowed him to detect an incoming imperial airstrike which had been incompetently called down on top of friendly units, allowing him to warn endangered men and save them. during fierce battle for hinzerhaus on took a mortal -wound to chest died twice whilst on operating table, but was brought back both times and ultimately pulled through, using his expertise to help major identify drawings of hinzerhaus power system which led to being able to restore power to fortress and supply fresh weapons to tanith when they were running direly low on ammunition. during mission to salvation's reach, acted as sweeper specialist for of trap-disarming teams which led way into enemy station. during return journey, was of three people who discovered that eagle stones recovered from station had fallen into an inexplicably neat pattern when disturbed and was later questioned by inquisition over incident, using his lip-reading skills to determine that inquisitor laksheema was keen to arrest . later, in undercroft of urdeshi palace, into reality-altering trap of a hidden woe machine but was led to safety by ayatani . has a long-running romance with his adjutant chiria, a scarred verghastite woman.
Dolan Chirosius: (of chiros) is an imperial , known as confessor. he was martyred by apostate in m36. during plague of unbelief he went to planet gathalamor (galactically south-west of terra) to demand its total surrender. however, was captured and forced into custody. was driven through streets, chained and whipped with flails. over an ordeal lasting over six months, he was constantly tortured, deprived of sleep, and had only a handful of water a day to live on. yet all while he remained defiant. ordered a public trial of upstart, charging him with blasphemy and heresy, along with treachery, sedition and rebellion for good measure. he wanted dead, but did not want to provide people with a to rally behind. he had to force to submit, so that he could be killed, painfully and over a long period of time. trial was broadcast across all of ' domains. after five months, prosecution had completed its case, and was allowed to present his defence - trial had to appear fair after all. for days, spoke; he inflamed countless planets against , explaining ' tyranny and encouraging worlds to rise up in arms. at end, spoke. he said 's own testimony had condemned him. was taken away to dungeons. after eight months, had still not given in to would-be ecclesiarch's torturers. when he finally died, his body was maimed beyond recognition, and left to wolves and vultures. carrion never had their banquet: confessor's body disappeared soon after and was never found. ' plan to shame backfired. in allowing confessor to speak, he allowed his message to spread further across stars than it would ever have done otherwise. on proclamation of 's death, ' empire erupted into revolt. almost as , 's grip on world after world was overthrown. palace itself was stormed, and in his household opened gates to let them in. made his way to spaceport, where he had a transport ready to evacuate should need arise. he never made it off planet. *"i tread path of righteousness. though it be paved with broken glass, i will walk it barefoot. though it crosses rivers of , i will pass over them. though it wanders wide, light of guides my step."
Dolomen: is a angels veteran sergeant. he assists high chaplain , with tracking down and bringing peace to sons of that fall to black rage.
Dolus: was forge of black templars dominar crusade. during crusade, he restored power to derelict cathedral ship diras while purged ship of its genestealer cult infestation.
Dominic Seroff: was an imperial guard commissar, a contemporary and later bitter rival of . was educated at same schola progenium as , and both were selected for commissariat and apprenticed to legendary commissar . at time of their deployment to mistral, reflected that, although he did not doubt 's dedication and ability, his appearance was too boyish, almost dandified, for him to be taken seriously as a commissar. never forgave , and did his utmost to ensure that never advanced through ranks of commissariat, and on more than occasion used his growing influence to assign to hazardous missions that would hopefully get him killed. to 's endless vexation, always survived. two men met again on armageddon, by which time was still an "ordinary" commissar, while had ascended to rank of commissar. 's hatred of was so vehement that he unconsciously sided with overlord as waaagh! ghazghkull overran planet. was no fool, and therefore recognized that every of 's decisions led to greater and greater disaster for defending imperial forces. as commissariat's ranking officer on planet, was only with ostensible authority to remove from command, yet he refused to do so, ignoring pleas from not just , but also of skulls titan legion, and canoness of adepta sororitas. mannehim noted with frustration that he had come within a hair's breadth of convincing , until 's name came up, and cut him off. himself questioned wisdom of his decision, but quickly convinced himself that "right" thing to do was to hold accountable, through any means necessary, for death and disgrace of , even if that meant siding with a megalomaniac incompetent like . was last seen witnessing, without objection, 's launching of virus bomb missiles across armageddon's surface, in false belief that munitions were virulent enough to eradicate invading orks. emerged from war as of greatest heroes not only of armageddon, but of entire imperium. for his complicity with , was in total disgrace, and was reassigned to a backwater planet (along with, ironically, another of 's nemeses, inquisitor ingrid schenk). there they were essentially marooned to nurse their hatred for and regret their falls from grace. after over a century of exile, world was suddenly struck by a mysterious plague which rapidly and horrifically killed its victims and mutated inanimate matter. plague was eventually revealed to be work of who sought to punish schenk for her expropriation and experimentation with plague of unbelief otherwise known as zombie plague, which herald of nurgle regarded as his own work. though they both survived initial outbreak, they were eventually overcome by raw mutations and delivered to terminus est. there they briefly encountered , who taunted and admonished them before triggering their own personalised afflictions, killing and dragging tortured and mutated schenk off to an unknown fate.
Dominus (Magos Biologis): was a magos biologis on forge world graia, during its invasion by orks. he was stationed at medicae station , along with magos biologis , where they worked to save lives of those wounded by orks. when medicae station later began to be overrun, quickly administered lethal overdoses to patients under her and ' care, despite his protests. having survived a previous invasion by orks, knew how vicious xenos would be and wanted to grant their wards a peaceful death, as her last act of mercy.
Domitius (Dark Angels): is a member of angels chapter, who is current commander of battle barge unrelenting . it was part of warfleet that served with ' 5th , as they defended imperial world husk from an ork invasion. unrelenting fought xenos' warships alongside strike cruisers sword of caliban and death of mercy. while mercy later left to pursue orks' fighter craft that fled from battle, and sword remained above world. battle barge was then meant to destroy invading orks with an orbital bombardment, after drew xenos to 5th 's location on husk. however just as orks neared , received an urgent message from angels' supreme . it contained orders of highest priority for unrelenting , which required that battle barge leave at once to fulfill them. immediately began preparations to do so, but informed of his new orders before departed from husk. however this meant 5th would now likely to suffer heavy losses at charging orks' hands.
Donas Maxim: is an aurora chapter codicier, who served in indomitus crusade as part of concilia psykana. he was also among crusade's forces that commander took with him to aid ultramar, during plague wars. during battle on iax worked with eldar farseer illiyanne natasé in order to attempt to shield imperial forces from of nurgle. they were forced to withdraw however after godblight was released.

Dontoriel: thumb|right|brother was a member of angels sanguinary guard. had been a for five centuries, and a sanguinary guard for last two. his many heroic deeds are listed upon his scroll of record in reclusiam on . most glorious among them was 's slaying of of borghan. in a battle that lasted for a day, he hacked apart daemon and ended monsoon of that had gripped world of viscydra for a decade. it was this deed that would earn him aureate honour – icon of a golden blade he would wear upon his armour with pride. despite this recognition, remained humble, seeking only to win glory for chapter that he served. he went on to serve by 's side during cryptus campaign. he would survive campaign and when angels' surviving forces returned to , was lauded as a hero for his efforts in cryptus system. he later took part in defending chapter's homeworld when it was invaded by hive fleet leviathan. by end stages of invasion, was among few defenders left and joined chapter 's final charge against hive fleet as it invaded their fortress monastery. he became last of sanguinary guard to keep pace with , before a large number of jumping tyranids forced him to ground and then tore him apart.

Dorain Hasker: was a sergeant of tanith and only, commanding regiment's ninth platoon. he and many of his platoon were killed in action on menazoid epsilon in worlds crusade when they were caught in a chaos energy field. they managed to avenge their own deaths, however, as their munitions went up when field hit them, destroying of field's projection towers. feedback caused by this tower's destruction also took down several others, preventing field from enveloping tanith lines.
Doranz: sergeant was gun commander of a basilisk of ketzok 17th armoured regiment. on voltemand, 'serpents' were commanded to travel through voltemand mirewoods to pavis crossroads in bokore valley. once there they were to shell voltis city and provide artillery cover for infantry operating in valley. en route to pavis crossroads, 'serpents' were attacked by world eater marines. after losing two basilisks and two guncrews, tanith and only emerged from woods and and killed marines, preventing them from slaughtering tightly grouped artillery crews. was man to supply colonel with his trademark licorice cigars, which he gave as thanks for counter-ambush. 's basilisk transported and of tanith regiment to their staging point for assault on voltis city. he admitted to being frightened by 's tanith pipes during assault, and he and bonded over a cigar during trip. would later take part in assault on oskray hive on sapiencia.

Dorner: was a space marine of black templars chapter. he was part of a chapter task force sent to planet stygia xii to reclaim abandoned keep of montgisard, where they would inter fallen sword brother within a dreadnought sarcophagus. matters were complicated, however, by existence of a chaos cult that had arisen on stygia xii and claimed keep as their base of operations. nonetheless space marines were able to make their way to montgisard's vaults; and stood outside to defend marines within while they installed in his shell. cultists led an attack on vault and was killed by a lucky shot that caught him in neck.
Doveskamor: is a member of aurora chapter. he was among many space marines that accompanied during terran crusade to reach throneworld. after reaching terra, a massive khornate army invaded imperial palace and joined in defence of palace. during battle of 's gate, he was part of command squad led by captain and reinforced palatine guard regiments fighting against daemons.
Dovrian Ofar: was a navigator and high-ranking member of navis nobilite in mid-m32 during war of beast. cousin twice removed of paternoval envoy , during beheading he was part of a conspiracy by and sitting paternova. with blessing of both figures, he killed and his wife and became new paternoval envoy in 's puppet cabinet.
Doyl: was a scout of tanith and only regiment. when and only were deployed in phantine theatre, was of sixteen tanith selected personally by colonel-commissar to take part in operation larisel. alongside troopers and and skyborne specialist , was assigned to team larisel 3 under sergeant . after successfully infiltrating pact-held city of ouranberg, larisel 3 tried to make their way through city by blending in with a work party of enslaved imperial citizens. however, and were separated from group and, while looking for them, was struck by a pact slaver with an electro-. this made him drop his pendant and, when slavers discovered it, they raised alarm and unleashed cyber-mastiffs to track him down. and were forced to break cover to save from being mauled to death by hate-dogs and this led to a firefight while they tried to get to safety. ultimately, and were cut down by loxatl mercenaries.

Ana Curth: was a surgeon who lived and worked in vervunhive on planet verghast and who later became a medic of tanith and only imperial guard regiment ( so-called "'s ghosts"). was assigned to inner hab medical hall 67/mv by time of siege of vervunhive. she was of many medicae charged with aiding refugees fleeing outer habs of vervunhive when hive came under attack by ferrozoicans in worlds crusade, having authority over a section of square of marshals near gate. while operating in conflict, struck up a friendship with chief medical officer of tanith and only, of regiments of astra militarum sent to aid vervunhive by crusade — not least when he subdued . this led to her accepting warmaster 's act of consolation and joining tanith as a medic in aftermath of war (vervunhive having been mostly destroyed and planned to be abandoned). although lacked experience in treating combat injuries prior to siege of vervunhive, she quickly adapted. even in earliest actions that regiment was deployed in following verghast, both and considered her a valued medic to tanith . she was also noted by some for being of verghastite "ghosts" to try to embrace certain aspects of tanith culture - in particular liberal use of tanith swear-word "feth" in place of verghastite "gak". she also developed a taste for sacra, although she initially didn't care for drink. when bulk of regiment was detailed as an honour guard on hagia, elected to remain behind to tend to those guardsmen who were wounded in retaking of holy doctrinopolis from infardi. was effectively chief medical officer for honour guard in his place. after honour guard sustained casualties in battle of bhavnager, it was decided to leave wounded in bhavnager with a garrison to protect town in preparation for honour guard's return journey. decided to stay to treat wounded, with becoming tanith's acting chief medic for remainder of mission. while stationed in bhavnager, became person that sergeant confided in regarding his family - prior to joining tanith in aftermath of vervunhive, believed that all of his family members (his wife and two children and ) had died in siege. to his shock, however, while deployed on hagia he discovered that his children had actually survived and were in care of fellow ghosts and . had decided not to reveal himself to children, afraid that it would emotionally scar them. agreed not to tell 's children that their was still alive, but felt that should have revealed truth. later, over course of phantine campaign, 's worries grew. she believed, partially based on testimony from sergeant to , that was starting to become suicidal. just prior to assault on ouranberg, she finally convinced to come clean, with agreeing to do so after battle was over.
Anahk'hir: is a daemon of nurgle. he was once summoned to planet sturmhex prime by captain of lords of decay. once there, he sought to use dying star sturmhex to open a warp rift that could form a bridgehead for of despoiler's black crusades. he was opposed by entire brotherhood of grey knights chapter, who had travelled to sturmhex prime after receiving a warning from their prognosticars. initially, saw this as an opportunity to exact revenge on who banished him back to warp. however, resulting battle went badly for daemon and his allies and, to add insult to injury, individual who banished him previously was not present. nonetheless, engaged in a duel with brotherhood's , , in an attempt to turn tide of battle. over course of duel, attempted to banish daemon by invoking 's true name, but was unsuccessful as he had been supplied with false information by inquisitor . however, was then attacked by a squadron of stormraven gunships, distracting daemon , who took to air to try and bring them down. in end, grey knights techmarine was able to grievously wound by ramming him with his stormraven, kodachi, allowing to imprison daemon within a tesseract labyrinth. following 's defeat, lords of decay and their daemonic allies were swiftly defeated and tesseract was presented to inquisitor. * was armed with a plague cannon and possessed a pair of wings.
Anakwanar Sek: |}} was of chaos warlords encountered during famed worlds crusade. he held title of "anarch", and was founder as well as chief commander of highly disciplined sons of . thumb|right| (as seen by [[colonel )]] a magister under archon , quickly became notorious to imperial forces of crusade as most brilliant tactician and strategist among 's lieutenants, with possible exception of heritor . when on balhaut in 765.m41, bloody fights for overall command of remaining chaos forces began. intelligence reports reaching imperial forces indicated that was favored candidate to succeed , but eventually would win upper , despite being neither a genius nor a charismatic leader. had what all other contenders did not: pact, a disciplined and experienced army, while other contenders commanded nothing but bands of fanatical cultists. continuing in a subordinate role, however, did nothing to diminish 's genius or his fearsome reputation among imperial crusade force. was chosen as of two commanders to spearhead 's vicious counterstrike against warmaster 's ambitious cabal salient. commanded a division of pact occupying enothis, which not only repulsed an imperial armoured offensive against his base in trinity hives, but nearly succeeded in establishing air superiority, using mobile aircraft carriers in desert to extend effective range of his air forces and bomb imperial cities far in advance of what imperial forces believed was possible. only after battle of zophonian sea were imperials able to turn tide, allowing militant humel's retreating forces to reach safety, consolidate with their reinforcements, and re-assault trinity hives. this second assault was successful, though escaped planet. combined efforts of and other magisters nearly succeeded in cutting off crusade's head in group, and counterstrikes caused millions of deaths among both imperial military personnel and citizens. part of what made so dangerous is that, atypically of all chaos warlords, including , he was capable of subtlety and finesse. he possessed a particular skill with propaganda, and use of terror as a weapon. he and both delighted in deliberately leaving vox channels on besieged imperial worlds open, so that nearby systems could hear defenders' frantic cries for help and reports of unthinkable atrocities committed by pact. where another chaos warlord might capture an imperial world with mass bombardment taking weeks, pact forces commanded by conquered many targets virtually overnight, after their defenders' morale simply collapsed. of 's "masterpieces" was addolorata incident, when an imperial fleet in retreat to friendly lines was fired upon by over-anxious gun crews of star forts they were attempting to reach, who had mistaken them for a disguised chaos force. before confusion was sorted out, imperial fleet was all but destroyed, and star forts badly mauled, allowing 's forces to sweep in and capture both with minimal losses. although situation in group was stabilized, warmaster remained wary of some new move by , who could not afford to underestimate. this is speculated to be of reasons why re-tasked militant and marshal blackwood with guarding rear flank of crusade, an apparently menial assignment which could have become vitally important if launched a new offensive from an unexpected direction. eventually, however, grew tired of his subordinate role and began building a new army in secret. it was on agri world that began training of sons of , an army that, like pact, was trained, organized, and equipped to same degree as imperial guard, but loyal only to . word of this reached crusade force, and some imperial tacticians speculated that crusade might help itself by provoking a civil war between and , although last thing imperial forces wanted was for to emerge victorious as new archon. after imperial raid on salvation's reach, became embroiled in a two-front war, battling both imperium as well as his rival . he ordered his officers to speed up recruitment for sons. ultimately, however, was finally cornered on urdesh in 792.m41; after was able to lure out with eagle stones, an ancient xenos device he greatly coveted. during battle on urdesh his death came at hands of scout sergeant , who shoved a mine into his gaping maw. psychic shockwave of his demise drove many of his followers instantly insane or outright killed them on and around urdesh. some surviving sons of attempted to restore through warp rituals; most failed. in ritual, however, damogaur gerik realized that 's ambition and scheming had been his ultimate undoing, and that his successor had to be truly empty and just follow orders of higher powers - thus he became new of , mutating into 's image yet completely different in his vision for future.

Andraaz: was a warsmith of warriors. leading legion's third , ruled over fortress world of castellax, enslaving its population to produce materials for medrengard. however sometime in m41 's rule of his world would come to an end when ork warboss biglug invaded planet in siege of castellax. as defeat seemed imminent, instructed his chief mechanicus techpriest to prepare to use daemonculum to teleport him directly into path of biglug, giving him an honorable and memorable death in combat. however unknown to , bitter techpriest, conspiring to free himself and his inventions from warriors control, sabotaged teleportation process. result was 's entire retinue of terminators, rending guard, were killed during teleporting sequence, while 's own terminator armor shut down in mid-combat against biglug due to a binary pulse emitted from a piece of equipment that had given greenskin warlord. now helpless, suffered an embarrassing and undignified death at hands of biglug.
