Andrej Valatok: was a storm trooper of 703rd legion storm trooper division, who served under captain in third war for armageddon. initially, his unit was tasked with guarding outpost d-16 west in wastelands of armageddon secundus. after reclusiarch uncovered existence of ordinatus armageddon beneath outpost, however, storm troopers were redeployed to hive helsreach to assist in defence of city against an invading ork horde. when helsreach faced a secondary invasion from tempest ocean, was amongst storm troopers assigned to oversee emergency militia units in helsreach docks. after being separated from bulk of imperial defenders, and his militia unit made their way to temple of ascendant, of last imperial fallback points in city and linked up with reclusiarch and his remaining black templars. temple was attacked by orks and collapsed during last battle. despite being buried in rubble, was amongst few survivors and suffered only minor injuries. in aftermath of siege of helsreach, was promoted to rank of captain in armageddon legion. he later took part in second siege of gap and survived. however, he was recorded in rolls of dead, leaving him unable to collect his pay. brought him up to crusader to complain to , who was not receptive to his complaints, and crusader started moving out of orbit while he was on it. it is not clear if he was able to reach a shuttle bay in time to depart crusader before it departed orbit.

Andus Hakur: was a veteran sergeant of death guard during crusade. serving under captain in 7th , was born on terra as opposed to barbarus and had tense relations with figures within his own legion such as calas typhon and . frowned down upon warrior lodges greatly, scolding when he found out he was part of . was among forces betrayed during battle of isstvan iii, but survived virus bombing of planet and managed to board eisenstein with . also managed to survive eisenstein's turbulent trip back to luna.

N'keln: was captain of third of salamanders space marine chapter. ascending to position after death of , 's period of leadership over was brief, but full of import. thrust into command rank unexpectedly and grieving for death of he nevertheless stoically endured many threats, including politically motivated attempts to have him removed from command, before being slain by base treachery. rising from senior veteran-sergeant status to that of captain, inherited a discontented . almost as soon as he took command, a leading member of his , sergeant , raised objections to his new rank with chapter himself. even when these objections were dismissed, remained convinced of error in appointing , an opinion that was shared by several of his fellows. aware of mutterings of discontent amongst his sergeants, and that he had large shoes to fill, initially made an attempt to send a signal to his men by offering — a source of tension in himself - position of champion. when refused this role, appeared to give up on making any changes to and instead concentrated on ensuring it was always prepared for battle. this focus on planning resulted in spending much of his time shuttered up with his command team, which only further earned of his detractors. led his on an investigative mission into belt (such a seemingly passive action once again earning chagrin of his detractors) in an attempt to discover location of renegade dragon warriors space marines. this decision proved to be inspired, as it eventually led to discovery of a relic of , lost salamanders primarch. 's command decisions were once again questioned by his juniors during this mission when he allowed a force of marines malevolent to “requisition” a shipment of astartes arms and armour that both had discovered aboard a damaged adeptus mechanicus . 's subsequent decision to immediately return to nocturne to present relic of to masters of chapter also drew complaints, even from his previous supporters. this return, so soon after setting out, having failed to save mechanicus equipment or personnel, smacked of failure to many in . went so far as to assemble a conclave of sergeants in in order to discuss going to chapter as a united front to act for 's replacement. this suggestion ultimately came to naught. relic of , when examined in relation to tome of provided information which led masters of chapter to divine a galactic location; world of scoria. 's 3rd , along with a detachment of drakes was dispatched to investigate. after their ship was damaged by a solar storm, 3rd crash-landed on planet. ordered majority of his to bunker crash-site, although he acceded to 's request to lead a scouting unit. when 's team ultimately discovered an warriors fortress brought up reinforcements to assault it, although his initial deployment led to unnecessary casualties shortly after fortress was secured by salamanders, it was assaulted again- this time by a massive ork horde. it was in this action that finally proved himself to and his other detractors, with his inspiring personal leadership, bravery and skill in face of seeming certain death. conceded that had been proved in fires of war and swore himself to question his captain no longer. however, it was at this, his moment of greatest triumph that . for scheme to replace was actually generated and kept going by manipulations of iagon, 's adjutant. with flatly refusing to continue scheme any longer, frustrated iagon, determined to remove , resulted to simple murder. sneaking up behind his captain in closing stages of battle, iagon treacherously slew with blade and malice. it is currently believed by rest of salamanders that died in battle with three ork infiltrators. salamanders tradition involves passing on of power armour and personal arms from captain to next. as 's physical body was mostly incinerated by a multi-melta strike, remains of his armour were used in his funeral instead. this resulted in having to wear a brand new suit of artificer armour created by . this suit was both highly functional and beautiful, encrusted with many decorative sigils and possessed of additional adamantium reinforcement sections. helm was a sleeker variant of mk vii, with grille worked into a fanged snout. it also possessed a removable gorget, presumably for additional neck protection. eschewed 's personal weapon, a thunder hammer, instead gaining a -crafted power sword. consisting of two separate, parallel blades mounted into a gold-plated dragon-headed and clawed pommel and guard, it was considered a masterpiece. it is currently unknown whether these arms have been inherited by his successor, captain .

Tomas Beije: |}} was regimental commissar of tallarn 229th during its deployment to adumbria in 937.m41. was in same schola progenium class as , and two disliked each other intensely. was always correct in adherence to rules and his piety to , and was quick to report any of his fellow cadets who he felt were not. and several of his less reverent classmates often delighted in playing pranks on their more strait-laced comrades, especially . two did not cross paths again until almost twenty years later, when tallarn 229th was deployed to adumbria alongside valhallan 597th, 's regiment. like many tallarn regiments, 229th was intensely , which made feel that 's assignment marked a stroke of good judgment (or luck) on part of departmento munitorum: in any other regiment, would likely have been "accidentally" shot during his engagement. inquisitor , editing 's memoirs, attached several dispatches by to his superiors, which included quotes from redemptionist tracts of "dubious theology and even worse literacy." by time of their next meeting, had become a celebrated hero of imperium, and a personal friend of general . these facts filled with a combination of bafflement, moral outrage, and seething envy. to his mind, it was somehow wrong - not to say impossible - that a man as lacking in discipline and proper fear of as should have risen so high, while himself had not. also shared his tallarn comrades' low regard for imperial guard regiments that included women, which increased friction between tallarns and valhallans prior to their deployment. during adumbria campaign, to defend world from a chaos invasion, sought to undermine at several times. in of above-mentioned dispatches to general's office, he implied that there was something at best cowardly, and at worst sinister, in fact that had been attached to two separate guard contingents that had stumbled onto sites of cultist summoning rituals, and, in both cases, had not arrived until after these rituals were completed. later, he asked an assembly of guard headquarters whether it was really believable that had defeated a world eater chaos space marine in single combat. played down his role in encounter, as usual, and managed to convince nearly everyone assembled. during climactic battle of campaign, commandeered a drop ship which had been ordered to frontlines, and diverted it to an oceanic dredger, where slaaneshi cultists were conducting a summoning ritual. seized on this action and pursued dropship with a squad of tallarn troopers, declaring under arrest for desertion, cowardice and subverting military resources. when valhallan troopers protested, brazenly ordered his tallarn escorts to shoot them all down. fortunately, tallarns were sensible enough to recognize that they were grossly outnumbered, and held back. while deriding 's claimed reasons for diverting troopship, also made mistake of insulting 597th's commander, colonel . stiffly challenged him to a duel when combat was over. broke standoff by declaring that their mission was in deadly earnest - a fact reinforced when battle erupted between cultists and an arriving force of world eaters. , confused, could only order his troopers to follow after as he and valhallans charged ahead in world eaters' wake. fittingly, was personally present when , for second time, narrowly defeated a world eater with his chainsword, a feat which cemented his reputation with valhallans and tallarns alike. likewise, 's accusations of cowardice rang hollow when and his troops confronted daemoness, , and banished her back to warp. did not distinguish himself during action, being noticeably petrified by appearance of daemon. for whatever reason, still insisted on putting before a commissariat tribunal. results were all could have hoped for: tribunal, with help of some discreet information provided by general , found innocent of any wrongdoing and commended him for his heroic actions; and on its own motion, brought charges against for conduct unbecoming a commissar. tribunal found that 's actions, had he carried them out, could have had worst consequences for planet. , writing his own memoirs years later, harshly echoed this sentiment, reflecting that 's "pig-headed stupidity... almost ended up handing an imperial world to ruinous powers neatly gift-wrapped with a pretty pink bow[.]" was stripped of his rank and was almost certainly facing execution, but promised to speak in his defense, and testify that 's actions, however ill-advised, came from only best intentions. privately, reflected that shooting him would not do anyone much good, and that it would be infinitely more satisfying to have in his debt for remainder of their lives. faced with prospect of a duel with , offered his humble apologies to colonel , before making a hasty exit.

Torris Vaun: was a rogue psyker from planet neva. as a young child, developed prodigious psychic powers, specializing in pyrokinesis. word of his abilities led to his being denounced by priest of his hometown's local church; retaliated by burning church down, with priest inside. word of this atrocity reached arch-confessor of governing ecclesiarchy, who secretly recruited psykers from neva's population. at their meeting, found charismatic and paternalistic, and warmed to him - to his later regret. was imprisoned inside keep, a secret fortress on neva staffed by 's acolytes, where individuals with psychic ability were experimented on and trained to use their abilities. became a protege of , who eventually used him as an assassin in his various schemes. at , enjoyed using his abilities in 's service, but eventually realized that he was a slave and escaped. demanded his recapture, ostensibly to punish him for his many crimes on neva. apprehended by adepta sororitas, was escorted back to neva by celestian 's squad, where his execution was supposed to be highlight of annual blessing of wound festival. before their arrival, however, broke out with help of mutinous naval crewman who had been corrupted by of 's rivals, baron holt sherring. during his escape, subdued and murdered sister . recruiting several other rogue psykers, unleashed havoc on neva, with two goals in mind: revenge on , and returning to keep, to mount "psychic engine" inside. because of psychic blocks on his mind, he was unable to remember location of keep himself, but tracked it down with help of baron sherring. captured again by 's squad, he tricked them into taking him to keep himself, promising to show them proof of 's heresy. once inside keep, he released other prisoners from their cells, creating a diversion that allowed him to enter chamber where psychic engine was kept. confronted him there, but threw him aside and mounted engine. at that moment, laughed, telling that every move he had made had been at 's will - engine would not imbue with any new psychic powers, but it needed a psyker of his power to "spark" its ignition. realizing he had been duped, furiously tried to overpower and destroy engine from within. vexed, drew a custom psycannon he kept as a back-up weapon, and shot through head - a fairly unglamorous death for such a flamboyant and powerful person.

face, at time of thirteenth black crusade was considered to be perhaps deadliest individual warrior in entire imperium, with his combat prowess approaching that of primarchs of old. those who know of ' existence speak of him with reverence and considered captain-general to be a representative of . originally an allarus custodian, he has run two successful games, a record that remains unbroken. while serving as an allarus custodian gained fame for destruction of space hulk mournful siren, defeat of genestealer cult of 's writhing shadow, and spearheading a preemptive strike against waaagh! centuries leading sorties throughout system and beyond. he was elevated to position of captain-general following death of launceddre during years of madness. his rise has seen custodes become most proactive they have been since age of apostasy. during his ruling number of games greatly increased, long-hidden cults of polar terran underhives have been purged, thirty-two separate extrasolar interdiction strikes were launched and defences of stable warp routes into system have been strengthened. it is said that it is moment shackle — a mysterious artefact of from history of old terra — that allowed him to predict 's return so that he managed to adapt adeptus custodes to new imperium in ascension of primarch. though captain-general traditionally only served as of high lords of terra under most dire of circumstances, as during war of beast, fervent persistence of chancellor persuaded to take seat left open by brach. had hoped that would serve as high lords' deciding vote to measure when pandemonium broke out as word of cadia's destruction reached high lords' chambers. later it is revealed that had been quietly preparing custodes for war for some time and had possibly Trajus Boniface: was a member of legion, during last years of crusade, where he served in 88th expedition. when expedition received a plea for assistance from 140th expedition, led by angels captain , led fourteen of 88th's vessels to world murder, in order to aid them. however when they arrived, discovered that primarchs and were leading imperium's forces in a campaign on murder, to exterminate megarachnids xenos that lived there; which had already killed and nearly entire 140 expedition as well. afterwards, not only offered his aid to , but also took opportunity to convince luna wolves primarch, to lend legion his aid for an attack on ork infested kayvas belt. proposed offensive against orks, was a long cherished plan created by primarch , but turned down; after he determined offensive would require too much time and manpower, than he could currently provide.
Trane: was a cadian sergeant in 7th of 473rd cadian rifles imperial guard regiment. he was veteran of uprisings on imperium worlds bairsten prime and agripinaa and later joined his regiment in defending kast thravius on cadia, after it was invaded by forces of nurgle. prior to kast thravius' invasion, plague of unbelief had spread like wildfire throughout cadia's sector and had turned critical stronghold into a necropolis, when forces of nurgle attacked. cadian guard sent its forces to reinforce, kast thravius and they fought for weeks to prevent it from falling into invaders' hands, but they soon only held its center; as death guard and guard and plague zombies they commanded, attacked them relentlessly. as battle dragged on, 's 7th defended lynchpin section of kast thravius still held by cadia, under command of colonel , when it came under attack by forces of herald of nurgle ; who sought to weaken cadian guard's hold on kast thravius and finally allow forces of nurgle to claim it. in brutal fighting that followed between two sides, led his squadron in doggedly holding 's forces back, until they became an annoyance to herald of nurgle, who soon called down swarms of plague flies to attack them. as swarms descended upon them, and his squadron became terrified as noxious flies began entering their rebreathers and fled building they had been firing from. unfortunately, their panicked run took them into path of a chaos champion and possessed chaos marines, who easily killed and his squadron. *1: white dwarf 282 (uk) — battle report: dawn of dead **: pg. 92 **: pg. 106 category:characters (cadian shock troopers) category:characters (astra militarum) category:characters (human)
Transacta-7Y1: was a skitarius of adeptus mechanicus' tr1.ax macroclade, active during siege of terra. was of last remaining defenders of palatine bastion of inner palace as it was overrun by . befriending imperial army sergeant sylas envaric despite her own radioactive weaponry slowly killing him, she was last survivor of bastion as it was overrun. later met up with during retreat towards eternity gate, saving him from forces and gaining his friendship in process. she took part in final battle for eternity gate alongside , though was grievously wounded by a group of world eaters led by bloodspitter. upon discovering her dead body, wept.
Trask (Lexicanium): was a lexicanium in ultramarines legion, who took part in heresy. he fought in heresy's battle of tallarn and was part of imperial reinforcements, that broke through blockade had around besieged world. their efforts to deploy on tallarn were spearheaded by ultramarines' drop pods and space marines would then secure a dropsite for additional reinforcements to upon. once ultramarines emerged from their drop pods, they were greeted by legio astorum , whose warlord titan fortunata imperiatrix had escaped from failed defense of rogsburg, which had fallen to . believed city could be retaken with aid of reinforcements, but before ultramarines could secure a dropsite they were attacked by a group of legio chaos titans. it was only due to intervention of fortunata imperiatrix, that not all of ultramarines were killed and thanks to 's efforts reinforcements were able to . and ultramarines then moved to retake rogsburg with aid of imperial titans. however city was held by thousand sons, who were able to repel several of imperial forces' attacks. in their next attempt, imperials sought to seize rogsburg's bromium refinery and lexicanium joined their efforts to do so. as they advanced towards thousand sons' battle lines, was envious that assault marine would be able to reach in refinery , due to his jump pack. however as lexicanum finally neared thousand sons' forces, he began to wonder if this was ' last stand for refinery or if ultramarines were entering a trap. however despite his concerns, rogsburg was retaken by imperials and afterwards, oversaw ceremony that denounced their slain foes and burned their banners. during ceremony, though, legio astorum spat on of enemy banners that was being burned. while ultramarines that had placed it in remarked that was being disrespectful, lexicanium said nothing and continued speaking. meanwhile ignored them all and left ceremony.

however as battle for terra began, captain ordered and his squadron to down a group of legionaries that had been found on luna, which had fallen to warmaster . was going to question need for eye's watch, as he thought their firepower would be overkill against a few , but he quickly changed his mind after seeing murderous threat in 's eyes. though still doubtful of his orders, did as he was command and found in luna's herodotus omega dome. once he saw , were of shattered , began to respect them as only most skilled could have survived dropsite massacre and then made their way to terra. eye's watch quickly began to upon , led by , as they retreated with selenar gene-witch . though did not know it, had been charged with protecting magna mater relic, which was sought after by . had gained aid in defending it, but as they sought to escape she was mortally wounded by eye's watch's . in order to ensure escaped with mater, dying gene-witch unleashed remaining ur-legionaries that remained sealed within herodotus omega dome. these powerfully strong failed legionaries were then able to kill most of 's squadron before they joined in death. only and two of eye's watch survived battle and began pursuing once more. due to injuries they suffered at justaerins' hands, eye's watch were able to catch up to just as they neared luna's surface. in order to ensure that magna mater escaped ' grasp, captains and fired upon eye's watch so that their comrade could escape with relic. because of their injuries and having few rounds of ammo left, were only able to kill of eye's watch before they died. now with only left, and his remaining squadron member urgave began their pursuit anew. by time they reached luna's surface, however, was able to escape aboard a storm eagle
